From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Saturday, June 9, 2018 3:12 PM
To: scott.cerny@detroittigers.com <scott.cerny@detroittigers.com>
Subject: Jeremiah Burks 
 
Hello Scott,

Anthony Fenech from the Detroit Free Press here. Hope the draft went well for you. Do you know who Burks' agent is? Also, working on a write-up on some of the lesser-known guys drafted. If you have a short scouting report on him, send it my way. No quotes.
